=== COPY EVERYTHING BELOW INTO Lovable ===
Redesign the Today and All reminders tabs of a small reminders app. Keep the look clean and calm. Settings stays as it is and is not part of this design.
=== END COPY ===

## Required behaviour

### Today — app/templates/index.html#today
- Shows: reminders where `done` is false, each with `title` and `due`, from `GET /api/reminders`
- Does: Done button marks a reminder done via `POST /api/reminders/{id}/done` (`markDone` in `app/static/app.js`)

### All reminders — app/templates/index.html#all
- Shows: every reminder with `title`, `due` and `done`, from `GET /api/reminders`
- Does: Done button on unfinished reminders, via `POST /api/reminders/{id}/done`

### Settings — app/templates/index.html#settings (not redesigned)
- Shows: a notification time input
- Does: Save shows "Saved <time>" in the browser (`app/static/app.js`); nothing is sent to the server

### Stakeholder must-haves
- A Done view that lists the finished reminders.
